This strong light appeared to be stationary, but it was not possible to identify its origin. Report from PP-SNA of VASP (T2/RE). Divert to that sector to confirm the existence of the mentioned object, as informed by the Tombota Air Force Base (FAB 1989 Cir/Re), that nothing was observed in the area from 2070 Pal.
